capabilities: Paste clipboard images into frontmatter text properties in Live Preview
Save pasted images to the vault's attachment path
Insert an image link as the property's content
Display property images via dataview queries
extras: Limited to Live Preview and text properties, replaces the whole property content, and has no mobile support.
intentEvidence: This functionality is currently missing in Obsidian as documented in this feature request.
problem: Obsidian's properties only accept text input, so there is no built-in way to paste an image from the clipboard into a property.

relations.evidence: Compatible with the paste imag rename plugin.

summary: Adds pasting clipboard images into frontmatter text properties in Live Preview, saving the file to the attachment path and inserting a link.
